newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Inland Resources initiated.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Inland Resources initiated.

text.p: - McDonald & Co said on Tuesday it initiated coverage of Inland Resources Inc at an aggressive buy rating.
- The stock was up 1/2 to 8-3/8 on Nasdaq.

- Analyst Jack Aydin said in a report his price target is $12, adding it is a suitable investment for those willing to accept the risks inherent in a small independent oil and gas producer. Its operations are in Utah, he said.
- "The company's strategy of aggressive, low-risk development drilling and selective acquisitions is expected to allow the company to quickly grow earnings and discetionary cash flow," Aydin said.
